name: Mārtiņš Staķis - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT From prototypes to capabilities – enabling new defence actors to scale up
part_text:
The European Parliament says Europe is good at inventing defence technology but bad at buying it. Start-ups and small firms win grants, then find no buyer and leave Europe. The report asks Member States to give these firms real first contracts, share testing and certification, pool some purchases, and treat Ukraine as a partner. It is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for first contracts, shared testing, easier rules and a bigger innovation programme.
- **Who it affects:** Defence start-ups, small firms, national armed forces and procurement offices, and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
